elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Stop deleting your photos every time storage is full.

[confident] Here's the fix. Offload the apps you never open.

[friendly] Open Settings, General, iPhone Storage. Tap Enable on Offload Unused Apps. Your photos and app data stay put.

[delighted] Gigabytes back, and every photo is still there.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
